## FCC Ni (110) ∥ (111) tilt boundary

| Grain / plane | X | Y | Z |
|---|---|---|---|
| Top, GB1 (110) | [0 0 −1] | [1 1 0] | [1 −1 0] |
| Bottom, GB2 (111) | [1 1 −2] | [1 1 1] | [1 −1 0] |

**Misorientation:** 35.2644°; common **〈110〉 tilt axis** [1 −1 0]. Y is the GB normal; Z is the tilt line.

**Closest CSL reference:** **Σ9 at 38.9424°**, with **Δθ = 3.6781°** (bounded search: Σ ≤ 50, plane indices ≤ 5). Construction retains the original (110) ∥ (111) geometry.

### Candidate periodic X cells

| Candidate | Top : bottom | PBC X (nm) | Relaxed (%) | Build (%) |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| P006 | 5 : 2 | 1.7630 | 1.9960 | 2.0204 |
| P012 | 11 : 4.5 | 3.8830 | 0.2512 | 0.2060 |

**P012 is the review-priority candidate.** P006 exceeds the <2% build-mismatch limit; P012 passes, and its half-integer bottom coefficient is FCC-compatible. Relaxed mismatch uses the mean grain length; build mismatch uses the maximum. Final cell selection remains yours.

NiCr.adp, a₀ = 3.52 Å. The source relaxation did not formally converge (`linesearch alpha is zero`); longer modulation remains unresolved within the finite observation window.

## Joint structure and elastic-strain periodicity

No expected repeat ratio was supplied. **P012 is the review-priority candidate**, with coordinate translation **3.8744 nm** and grain translations **11a[00−1] : 4.5a[11−2]** (top : bottom). Its independently measured atomic-row motif is **3.8804 nm**; the two nearby lengths are distinct measurements. About **4.6 cycles** fit in the observed boundary, and the near-interface coordinate RMS is **0.0915 Å**.

The review score **0.961** combines atomic-row agreement (0.999), local-strain evidence (0.930), and coordinate geometry (0.940). It guides inspection and does not establish a unique physical period or select a cell.

| Alternative | Coordinate translation | Top : bottom lattice coefficients | Observed cycles |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| P006 | 1.7433 nm | 5 : 2 | 10.23 |
| P007 | 2.1310 nm | 6 : 2.5 | 8.37 |
| P005 | 1.3561 nm | 4 : 1.5 | 13.15 |
| P024 | 7.7496 nm | 22 : 9 | 2.30 |

The analysis retains **30 coordinate candidates**, of which **14 pass the two-grain pure-X lattice check**. No supported longer-modulation candidate is reported. P024 spans only about 2.3 cycles; the finite observation window cannot exclude a larger modulation or identify secondary dislocations.

### Candidate continuous-periodic X cells

| Candidate | Top counts | Bottom counts | Nominal PBC X | Relaxed mismatch | Construction mismatch |
|---|---|---|---:|---:|---:|
| P012 | [11,21,3] | [4.5,17,3] | 3.8830 nm | 0.2512% | 0.2060% |
| P006 | [5,21,3] | [2,17,3] | 1.7630 nm | 1.9960% | 2.0204% |
| P007 | [6,21,3] | [2.5,17,3] | 2.1586 nm | 2.0860% | 2.0204% |
| P005 | [4,21,3] | [1.5,17,3] | 1.4110 nm | 8.4449% | 8.1441% |
| P024 | [22,21,3] | [9,17,3] | 7.7630 nm | 0.2512% | 0.2060% |

Relaxed mismatch uses the mean of measured grain lengths; construction mismatch uses their maximum and the original lattice parameter. P006, P007, and P005 exceed the construction policy of <2%. P012 and P024 pass this comparison. The P012 bottom coefficient **4.5 is an allowed FCC lattice translation along [11−2]**, as confirmed by the new lattice check; compatibility alone does not prove a structural period. These options retain the source Y/Z counts (material Y ≈20.8185 nm, Z ≈1.4934 nm).

Full FFT spectra, strain fields, local intervals, atomic-row measurements, and all candidate details are indexed in the run manifest. The joint overview above is the default display.
